ssh-open-world.title: SSH not open to the world

steps.1: Open the security group and find the 0.0.0.0/0 rule on port 22.
steps.2: Replace it with your office or VPN CIDR, or move to a bastion host.
steps.3: Re-run the scan to confirm the finding is gone.

rdp-open-world.title: RDP not open to the world

steps.1: Open the security group and find the 0.0.0.0/0 rule on port 3389.
steps.2: Restrict it to a known CIDR or publish the desktop through a gateway.
steps.3: Re-run the scan to confirm the finding is gone.

any-open-world.title: No all-ports ingress from the world

steps.1: Locate the rule with protocol -1 and source 0.0.0.0/0.
steps.2: Split it into explicit per-port rules with narrow sources.
steps.3: Re-run the scan to confirm the finding is gone.

steps.1: Remove AllUsers and AuthenticatedUsers grants from the bucket ACL.
steps.2: Set public-access prevention to enforced and serve files through signed URLs.
steps.3: Sync the account and re-run the scan.

steps.1: Snapshot the volume, then copy the snapshot with encryption enabled.
steps.2: Create a new volume from the encrypted snapshot and swap the attachment.
steps.3: Delete the unencrypted volume and its snapshot.

stopped-but-billable.title: No stopped VMs paying for storage

steps.1: Decide whether the VM is still needed.
steps.2: If not, snapshot it and terminate it so the volumes are released.
steps.3: If it is, move the data to cheaper storage or accept the cost.

steps.1: Check with the owner tag whether the VM is still wanted.
steps.2: Take a final snapshot for safety.
steps.3: Terminate the VM to stop storage billing.

steps.1: Open the account and read its required-tag list.
steps.2: Apply the missing keys in bulk from the Tags page.
steps.3: Add an auto-tag rule so new VMs get them at sync time.

steps.1: Confirm the source volume no longer exists.
steps.2: Export the snapshot if you still need the data.
steps.3: Delete the snapshot to stop storage billing.

steps.1: Confirm no VM needs the volume any more.
steps.2: Snapshot it if the data still matters.
steps.3: Delete the volume to stop storage billing.

steps.1: Check whether a DNS record still points at the address.
steps.2: Re-attach it to a VM or update DNS first.
steps.3: Release the address to stop the hourly charge.

rotate.title: Rotate {name}?
rotate.description: A new value replaces the current one. Anything still using the old value breaks.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: The encrypted value is removed for good. This cannot be undone.
